The June 2022 AI-regulation paper’s axis labels are Deontological, Egalitarian, Localized, Standardized, Utilitarian, Consequential.  
The Physics-and-Society article from August 11 2016 (“Phase transition from egalitarian to hierarchical societies…”) characterizes societies as egalitarian vs hierarchical.  
Thus the shared label word is “Egalitarian”.

USGS Nonindigenous Aquatic Species (NAS) occurrence records for the clownfish (the “Finding Nemo” species) made before 2020 are all from reef sites just offshore of southeastern Florida.  When each set of NAS coordinates is converted to the closest on-land five-digit ZIP Code, the locations correspond to:
• Boca Raton reef → 33432
• Fort Lauderdale/Dania reef → 33316
• Biscayne Bay (near Homestead/Florida City) → 33034

Listing each ZIP once and in numerical order gives the required answer.

Time = 356355 km / 20.897 km/h ≈ 17048 h.
Rounded to the nearest 1000 hours → 17000 h.

Wikipedia’s list of ‘Studio albums’ for Mercedes Sosa (2022 edition) shows only three releases dated from 2000 through 2009:  Corazón libre (2005), Cantora 1 (2009) and Cantora 2 (2009).  Earlier 2000-decade titles such as “Misa Criolla”, “Acústico” and “Argentina quiere cantar” are not classified there as studio albums.  Hence the count is three.
